{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for the treatment arm only
treatment_df = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Check the number of patients in the treatment arm
treatment_count = len(treatment_df)

# Check how many of them responded
treatment_responded_count = treatment_df['responded'].sum()

# Calculate the fraction
treatment_response_fraction = treatment_responded_count / treatment_count

treatment_response_fraction"}
